CXSAST_PROJECT_ID.description: Optional CxSAST project id (numeric) to scope the import. When set, only that project's most recent finished scan is imported via /cxrestapi/projects/{id} + /cxrestapi/sast/scans?projectId=<id>&last=1. Ignored when CXSAST_SCAN_ID is also provided. Omit both to enumerate every project visible to the user and import each project's latest finished scan.

CXSAST_SCAN_ID.description: Optional CxSAST scan id (numeric) to import directly. When set, the executor skips project enumeration entirely and pulls results via /cxrestapi/sast/results?scanId=<id>; the owning project is looked up via /cxrestapi/sast/scans/{id} for host naming. Takes precedence over CXSAST_PROJECT_ID. Omit to use the last-finished-scan-per-project flow.

CXSAST_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Minimum Faraday severity bucket to import. Valid values: info, low, medium, high, critical. Enforced client-side after severity normalisation (handles CxSAST's string severities — High/Medium/Low/Information — and its 0-4 numeric severity index, with CVSS v3 fallback when only a numeric score is given). Default: info.

name: checkmarx_sast
title: Checkmarx SAST
description: Checkmarx SAST (CxSAST 9.x) REST API importer. Pulls source-code findings from a CxSAST manager and emits Faraday bulk-create JSON to stdout. Lists projects via /cxrestapi/projects (or fetches a single project via /cxrestapi/projects/{id} when CXSAST_PROJECT_ID is set), resolves each project's most recent finished scan via /cxrestapi/sast/scans?projectId=<id>&last=1 (skipped when CXSAST_SCAN_ID is set — that scan is imported directly), then pulls per-scan results via /cxrestapi/sast/results?scanId=<id> paginated with offset/limit. Each project becomes one Faraday host (synthetic 0.0.0.0 because SAST findings live in source repos, not on IPs); per-scan results are attached as Faraday vulnerabilities — one per CxSAST result id with [SAST] engine prefix, queryName, CWE-* refs, queryId/CxQuery refs, file:line + sink location and similarityId enrichment in the description. Severity normalised from CxSAST's string severities (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Information, also accepts informational/moderate) and from CxSAST's 0-4 numeric severity index (0=info, 1=low, 2=medium, 3=high, 4=critical), with CVSS v3 fallback when only a numeric score is given; client-side min-severity floor enforced after normalisation. Status mapped from CxSAST's lifecycle status (new/recurrent/active → open, fixed/resolved → closed) combined with analyst state — NOT_EXPLOITABLE and PROPOSED_NOT_EXPLOITABLE (string or numeric codes 1 / 4) become Faraday risk-accepted. Auth: OAuth2 password grant against /cxrestapi/auth/identity/connect/token with the default CxSAST resource_owner_client client_id and the well-known client_secret shipped with the appliance (scope=sast_rest_api); the access_token is sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on every API call. CXSAST_HOST is the CxSAST manager base URL (e.g. https://cx.corp.example.com).
